cases.name: Donna G. Lay
cases.about: Please send information about her life, dreams or interests to shecounted@gmail.com
cases.narrative: Her body was found in a garbage can that had been placed in a closet in his apartment, sealed with duct tape, wrapped with black plastic, and sealed with tape again in an apparent effort to hide the odor of a decaying body. She had been in there approximately 3 weeks. Shot in head.
